EVERY CUSTOMER HAS A STORY.

A quiet village. A small egg cart. And something terribly wrong hiding behind familiar faces.

Download for Android Download for Windows

A simple business.
A dark secret.

Take responsibility for your father's egg cart and serve customers in a quiet village. But as the days pass, strange events begin to unfold. Something is not right, and every customer may be hiding a secret.

From the village

Captured in-game. Select any image to view it full size.

What waits in the dark

First-person horror experience

See everything through your own eyes. Nowhere to look away, and nothing to hide behind.

Atmospheric village environment

Empty lanes, dim lamps and a silence that never quite settles.

Mysterious customers

Familiar faces with polite smiles. Some of them are not telling you everything.

Story-driven gameplay

Every day at the cart adds a little more to a story you may not want to finish.

Psychological horror

Dread builds slowly. What you imagine is worse than what you see.

Unexpected encounters

A routine order can turn into something you never saw coming.

Take the cart. Free to download.

    Privacy Policy

    Last updated: November 11, 2026

    Who we are

    ANDA CART is a first-person horror game developed by Sarim Productions (“we”, “us”). This policy explains what information is handled when you visit this website or download and play ANDA CART on Android or Windows. If you have any questions, contact us at sarimforbusiness@gmail.com.

    Information we collect

    • Website visits: like most websites, our hosting provider and tools such as Google Search Console may process technical data such as your IP address, browser type, device type and pages viewed, to deliver the site and keep it secure.
    • Downloads: installers and APK files are hosted on GitHub. GitHub may process technical data when you download a file, under its own privacy policy.
    • Emails you send us: if you contact us, we receive your email address and whatever you choose to write, and use it only to reply.
    • In the game: ANDA CART does not ask you to create an account and does not ask for your name, contact details or payment information. Game progress and settings are stored locally on your device.

    How we use information

    We use the limited information above to run and secure the website, to deliver downloads, to answer your messages, and to improve the game. We do not sell your personal information.

    Third-party services

    This site links to or relies on third parties such as GitHub (file hosting), Google (search and site tools), and Instagram (our social page). These services have their own privacy policies and we do not control how they handle your data.

    Cookies

    This website does not set its own cookies for tracking or advertising. Third-party services you choose to visit through links may use cookies under their own policies.

    Children’s privacy

    We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. ANDA CART is a horror game with scary themes and is not intended for young children. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

    Data retention and your rights

    We keep emails only as long as needed to respond to you. You can ask us at any time to access or delete information you have sent us by writing to sarimforbusiness@gmail.com. Game data stored on your device can be removed by clearing the app’s data or uninstalling the game.

    Security

    We take reasonable steps to protect the information we handle, but no method of transmission or storage over the internet is completely secure.

    Changes to this policy

    We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.
